entry.title: dotnet/sdk - Issues & Pull Requests - 2025-12-02
entry.content:
Issues

Created

  • [dotnet-watch] Disable Hot Reload for projects without SupportsHotReload capability #51981
  • .NET 10 Microsoft.Testing.Platform skips `.esproj` tests #51977
  • Better support for building against newer frameworks than SDK supports #51974
  • [dnceng-bot] Branch `sdk/release/9.0.1xx` can't be merged to Azdo internal branch #51973
  • New csproj files should use "/" as path seperator #51972
  • [Regression] `dotnet sln add` with 2 projects on the same directory produces an invalid solution #51970
  • Revise test templates TFM+LangVersion combinations #51969
    11.0.1xx
  • question: debugging services ran out of memory #51967

Closed

  • .NET 10 Regression: `ToolCommandName` is no longer being set by the SDK. #51739
  • `dotnet list package` error `Sequence contains no matching element` targeting `netcoreapp3.1` #51700
  • Prune data for netcoreapp2.1 and below contains Microsoft.NETCore.App, but it shouldn't #49917
  • Option in CPM to use 'newest available' floating version resolution (highestMinor or highestPatch) instead of oldest available #51939
  • Option to explicitly ignore `packages.lock.json` file when present on disk #51938
  • Granular control for package updates in `RestoreLockedMode` (selective updates) #51940
  • Inconsistent WorkingDirectory behavior between Windows and Linux for File-based apps #51778
    10.0.2xx
